description: Fuse two or more records of the same entity into a new arbitration record. Without arbitration_model use voting, median and union rules; with an arbiter, conflicts may incur LLM cost. Returns output, conflicts, fusion metadata and a new record ID. The merged result can feed linked databases and overwrite current entity values. Inspect database warnings and the actual fusion method; an arbiter failure can fall back to rules. Use this after separately recovered model runs, not to merge different entities. See enricher://docs/enrichment-and-fusion.

arbitration_model.description: Model composite key for LLM arbitration (None = rule-based).
arbitration_model.title: Arbitration Model

attachment_ids.description: Attachments passed to the arbitration LLM (ignored for rule-based merges).
attachment_ids.title: Attachment Ids

result_ids.description: UUIDs of the enrichment records to merge (minimum 2).
result_ids.title: Result Ids
